Container.Name: claude-usage-analyzers
Container.Overview: Nightly rule-based analyzers for claude-usage-tracker (no LLM, no network). Also pulls scheduled-task runs from the relay folder before each run. Shares the Data folder with claude-usage-tracker.
Container.PostArgs: -c "while true; do [ -d /relay/runs ] && python -m server.relay_pull --relay /relay --db $TRACKER_DB; python -m analyzers.run --db $TRACKER_DB --rules; sleep ${INTERVAL_SECONDS:-86400}; done"

Config.Name: Relay (optional)
Config.Description: Git checkout of claude-usage-relay; do the git pull from a User Script since this container has no network

Config.Name: INTERVAL_SECONDS
Config.Description: How often to rerun the analyzers
